    vertical_layout: fill

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)

library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)

library(plotly)
```

```{r}
data(nyc_airbnb)

nyc_airbnb = 
  nyc_airbnb |> 
  select(
    neighbourhood_group, neighbourhood, rating, price, room_type, lat, long) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(rating), 
    neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan",
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    price %in% 100:500)

rmarkdown::render("dashboard_template.Rmd", output_format = "flexdashboard::flex_dashboard")
```
-have to use rmarkdown to avoid overwriting

Column {data-width=650}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Scatterplot

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |> 
  mutate(
    text_label = str_c("Price: $", price, "\nRating: ", rating)
  ) |> 
  plot_ly(
    x = ~lat, y = ~long, type = "scatter", mode = "markers", 
    color = ~price, text = ~text_label, alpha = 0.5
  )
```

Column {data-width=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Boxplots

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |> 
  mutate(neighbourhood = fct_reorder(neighbourhood, price)) |> 
  plot_ly(y = ~price, color =~neighbourhood,
          type = "box")
```

### Chart C

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |> 
  count(neighbourhood) |> 
  mutate(neighbourhood = fct_reorder(neighbourhood, n)) |> 
  plot_ly(x = ~neighbourhood, y =~n, vtype="bar", color = ~neighbourhood,
          colors = "viridis")
```
